title: A PDF redirect with a non-numeric port escapes the downloader
description: Found by HW2 round 1 (ARA-117). ContentDownloader.fetch builds httpx.Request from a redirect target before the transport validates it. A Location such as https://<storage>:abc/x raises httpx.InvalidURL, which is neither httpx.HTTPError nor ValueError, so it leaves fetch instead of returning the unsafe_url outcome. No request is sent, so the rule that PDFs come only from OpenAlex storage on the default port still holds. services/fulltext.py has no handler for it either.
acceptance_criteria: Given a redirect whose port is not a number, when the PDF is fetched, then the outcome is unsafe_url and no further request is sent.
verification: Reproduced on 2026-11-08 with --runxfail: httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid port: 'abc', raised from openalex_content.py:176. Tracked by the strict xfail test_a_redirect_with_a_malformed_port_is_refused. Not fixed: round 1 changes tests only.
